title: Split-preparation ready configuration
statement: For each $k\in\mathbb{N}$, let $w$ and $s$ be finite Boolean strings, let $q\in\{0,1,2\}$, and let $h\in\mathbb{Z}$. The split-preparation construction assigns a configuration on input $w$ with state $(q,\,|w|<|s|)$, input-head position $P(w,|s|)$, first work tape $B(s)$, and each remaining work tape $C_{|s|+1}$; every work-tape head is at $h$, and the output is empty.
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the input-position, buffer-tape, or catalog-tape constructions; $P$, $B$, and $C$ name those constructions here, so their contents cannot be made more explicit from the supplied information.
